fluff.overview: Most Clan infantry are solahma warriors at the end of their careers or who have failed their Trials, assigned to duties the warrior caste considers beneath notice. Field Artillery Points provide indirect fire support that allows infantry formations to engage targets beyond visual range. Operating from concealed positions behind the front line, these crews deliver area-effect fire that can disrupt enemy formations, destroy fixed positions, and support advancing friendly units without exposing themselves to direct engagement. The Point operates a Sniper artillery piece, a medium-weight field gun that delivers heavier bombardment than a Thumper with greater blast radius and destructive effect against fortified positions.
